title: fix(slot): cut the round ends of a slot wider than the tool
body:
## What changed

- A Slot wider than its tool now runs one wall lap at each level, after the rows.
- The lap follows the boundary of the tool centre stadium: two straight sides and two half circles.
- Each half circle is a chain of arcs (G02/G03). The chain is split at every row end on it and at its tip, so no arc is more than 90 degrees.
- The rows and the lap compute a row end with one function (`cap_point`). Each row join meets the lap at the same point to the bit.
- The lap starts where the last row ends and closes at that point.
- Under `climb` the lap is counterclockwise (the slot's air on the left, the same sense as the rows). Under conventional it is clockwise.
- A full-width slot (`h = 0`, one row on the centre line) does not change.
- The lap code is in the new module `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_lap.rs`. `slots.rs` is 394 lines.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/2906-slot-round-ends.md`.

## Cause

A row touches a round end only at its end point. The move between two rows is a straight line. The tool did not follow the arc between two row ends. On a 10 mm slot with a 6 mm tool, 0.86 mm stayed on the wall of each round end.

## Why the arcs are split at the row ends

The first version used two quarter arcs for each cap. The quick gate refused it on 8 app suites. The verifier's crossing law (a) flattens an arc into chords inside its circle. A row join is a chord that ends exactly on the circle, so it crossed those flattened chords, and the post was held. With the split, the join and the lap share their vertices. The law reads a shared vertex as a touch, not a crossing. The crossing law does not change.

## Tests

- New pin: `crates/motion/tests/slot_round_ends.rs`
  - `wide_slot_cuts_its_round_ends_climb`
  - `wide_slot_cuts_its_round_ends_conventional`
  - `wide_slot_with_rows_off_the_tips_cuts_its_round_ends`
  - Each point on the stadium wall must be within the tool radius of the tool centre path (limit 0.01 mm). No tool centre point may leave the cutter centre stadium. `crossed_pairs` (the verifier's crossing law) must be empty.
  - Red before the fix: `climb=true z=9: 0.855 mm left on the wall at (28.536, 18.536)`.
- New unit tests in `slot_lap.rs`: the lap closes on its start; each row end is a lap vertex; CCW from `b` runs the +n side first; CW from `b` turns round `b` first.
- Mutations repeated on head `35020f6cc294c3b6266be720b3c9d2b178c970f9`:
  - Disable the wall lap: all three `slot_round_ends` tests fail. The climb and conventional tests leave 0.855 mm on the wall. Restore the source: all three tests pass.
  - Remove the row-end splits: `wide_slot_with_rows_off_the_tips_cuts_its_round_ends` fails its crossing assertion. Restore the source: all three tests pass.
  - Both restorations match the reviewed source byte for byte. The worktree has no source changes.
- Expected-change test updates:
  - `crates/motion/tests/machining2d.rs`: `slot_offsets_rows_across_a_wide_channel`, `conventional_slot_starts_at_the_far_end`, `slot_stock_to_leave_narrows_the_center_area` read the rows as the prefix of the level and pin the lap (arc count, direction, tips at x = -7 and 47, close at the last row end). `slot_helix_orbits_in_the_certified_channel` counts only descending arcs as the helix.
  - `crates/app/tests/operations.rs` (`an_entry_edit_marks_the_slot_stale_and_the_orbit_proves_itself`): an orbit is a descending arc. The planar arcs are the lap.
  - `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/case_2d_slots.rs`: the Slot now has 8 arc blocks (4 for each level).
  - `crates/app/tests/clearance_in_stock.rs` (`a_slot_traverse_at_a_clearance_plane_inside_the_stock_is_convicted_and_holds_the_post`): see "Side effect" below.

## Final-head validation

Head: `35020f6cc294c3b6266be720b3c9d2b178c970f9`. No new commit was needed for this validation request.

Base: `upstream/main` at `a35c9cb8197f484fca0f8311610bdc8594111a0f`. The diff merge base is `11402dba4c849c5f827dccebc14f850196614311`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 732 steps; 731 pass and one fails its time limit.
- The failed test is `adaptive_troch_parallel::wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes`. It takes 123.369 seconds against a 90-second debug limit. No geometry assertion fails.
- The isolated failed-step retry uses `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=1`. Its one gate step passes; both tests pass. The suite takes 107 seconds.
- The CL and post fixture readers pass. The changed golden readers pass.
- Motion library tests: 494 pass, 10 ignored. The three `slot_round_ends` pins pass.
- App `operations`: 121 pass, 6 ignored. App `example_catalog`: 33 pass, 2 ignored.
- App `clearance_in_stock` and `solid_law_goldens` pass.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: exit 0. All 235 steps complete in 109.1 minutes, with zero unexpected failures. Both reached lanes, motion and app, run in full.
- Reached motion lane: 37 steps, 57 tests pass, 2 expected failures reproduce.
- Reached app lane: 197 steps, 43 tests pass, 4 expected failures reproduce. The shared build is the remaining step.
- Six known-fail tests produce their expected red results. The gate accepts these expected results.
- Motion heavy library tests: 8 pass. Motion `finish3d`: 33 pass.
- App heavy `operations`: 6 pass. App `rotary_field_parity`: 6 pass in 864.35 seconds.
- App `shared_face_bodies_finish`: 6 pass in 2268.32 seconds.

Expected failures:

- `motion heavy: known fail #1950 the_stock_ring_level_reaches_the_air_planner_with_the_stock`
- `motion heavy: known fail #1950 the_stock_ring_level_plans_adaptive_with_no_budget_note`
- `app heavy: known fail #2849 an_axis_aligned_lead_start_posts_the_users_arc_entry_as_g18_or_g19`
- `app heavy: known fail #2849 the_horizontal_arc_entry_on_the_users_pocket_verifies_silent`
- `app heavy: known fail #1950 the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`
- `app heavy: known fail #2849 fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works`

- `env -u RUSTC_WRAPPER -u RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0 in 4 minutes 8 seconds.
- The final worktree is clean. No golden file changes remain. The head is unchanged.

## Side effect (please check in review)

In `clearance_in_stock`, the slot's lateral traverse between its levels was convicted only because the uncut crescents of the round ends stood in its path. The traverse stays inside the slot's own channel. With the ends cut, the verifier acquits it. The plane is still convicted by the first traverse (`FirstTraverseLow`, #2901) and by the rapid from the plane down into the stock (`RapidInStock { at: 1 }`). The post is still held with "travels through stock". The test now asserts these facts.

## Goldens moved

All in `slot_wide_channel_rows` and the catalog case `2d/slots`.

- `crates/app/tests/golden/slot_wide_channel_rows.cl`: 12 lap moves added (2 lines, 10 arcs; each cap split at the rows -7, -3, 1, 5, 7 and the tip). The header changes from `v1` to `v2` because the CL now has arcs.
- The NC golden of each dialect (`nc/`, `carvera`, `doosan-dnm`, `grbl`, `grblhal`, `haas`, `heidenhain`, `linuxcnc`, `mach4`, `mazak`, `sinumerik`, `tinyg`, `tormach`, `tormach/explain_`): the same 12 moves added. In `heidenhain` and `sinumerik` the block numbers after the lap move up. No other line changes.
- Catalog case `examples/catalog/2d/slots` (`cargo xtask catalog --case 2d/slots`):
  - `slots.nc`: 6 lap moves added at each of the two levels (rows at -2, 0, 2: each cap is two quarter arcs).
  - `slots.camproj`: the cached Slot moves gain the lap. The stamps change.
  - The first rapid's `from` of the two operations changes from `(0, 0)` to the start point. This change is also in the Trochoidal slot, which this PR does not change. It is drift of the catalog file on main, written by the catalog tool. I kept the tool's output and did not edit it by hand.

## Not exercised

- The app's `verify` was not run by hand on the catalog case. The suites that post it (`example_catalog`, `solid_law_goldens`) are green.
- Ramp and Helix entries with the lap ran only through the existing slot tests.

## Overlaps

None. No open PR changes `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot*.rs` or the catalog case `2d/slots`. The branch merges cleanly with the current `main` (`8be100737`).

Changelog: A Slot wider than its tool now cuts its two round ends to size with a wall lap at each level; before, up to 0.86 mm stayed on the end walls.

Effort: high

Fixes #2906
